mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment (below 2.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (20-day rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, triggering a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations fall, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline by >1% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates pressure valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months, indicating weakening manufacturing activity, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO has declined over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) below 500,000 million dollars signals reduced household consumption, lowering corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS < 500000.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%), tight labor market conditions drive wage pressures and inflation, prompting Federal Reserve policy tightening that results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,200,000 units signals construction sector contraction, reducing economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1200.
